additions.sourceIdentityEvidence: The source seller specification explicitly identifies brass, 200 × 200 mm, 0.5 mm thickness; the gallery dimension image corroborates the metric cut and thickness. Whole square, plain golden metal, sharp unrounded corners and visible fine natural surface grain match the unbranded ATEHNA brass sheet specification and original appearance. The supplier has a copied Copper Sheets package-content/graphic label despite brass title, brass material field, brass description and golden main; this copy conflict is recorded and no supplier graphics or purity/alloy claims are imported. Walmart and the Unique Bargains BBB listing independently expose the same brass product family. ATEHNA sale quantity, model/specifications and inactive status are unchanged.

The native manufacturer image has the identical SHA to the CreaKnutselen reseller original; whole-sheet shape,white colour and fine drawing surface are compatible.
